# Evidence
- Problem class: typescript-cli-space-form-flag-normalization
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-09-17T00:47:41.138Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: A hand-rolled CLI arg parser that splits only on '=' (parseArgs) silently turns a space-form value flag (--namespace ns) into the boolean string "true" and leaks the value into the positionals. Third instance in the same CLI (recall --namespace, recall --as-of, forget --namespace, now remember --namespace/--domain/--content). Loud case: an enum-validated flag errors with the option list. SILENT case: a plain string flag becomes "true", which is truthy, so the write lands in a resource literally named "true" with no error. Fix: a normalizeSpaceFormFlags(args, [--flag, ...]) pre-pass that splices [flag, value] into [flag=value] for the VALUE-TAKING flags only, applied per command before parseArgs (never globally); boolean flags must be excluded or they swallow the next token. Proof recipe: unit suite with the tool mocked asserting CALL ARGS for space form, equals form (unchanged), boolean-flag-not-consuming-next-token, and unknown-flag-still-rejected; then a live scratch-resource probe with a NEGATIVE CONTROL run against the pre-fix code showing the same command landing in the wrongly-named resource.
